_readme: One entry per city permit portal. To add a Tyler EnerGov city: copy an entry, change base_url, pull one month with --list-types, then fill the type lists. Every type list here is an ASSUMPTION made by the team, not a city or HCD definition; have a planner review it.

laguna_beach.name: Laguna Beach
laguna_beach.source_notes: Public Citizen Self Service search, no login. No robots.txt (404) and no terms of use found on 2026-11-10. The link from the city's own website has NOT yet been confirmed by a person.
laguna_beach.assumption_note: ASSUMPTION (team, 2026-11-10, not reviewed by a planner): the lists below were chosen from the type and status names the portal returned for 2023-01 to 2026-10. 'Residential Planning Entitlements' is left out because its only work class is 'Zoning Plan Check', which looks like a review step inside the building permit, not a land use approval; that reading is unconfirmed.
